headline: Potential U.S.-Iran Deal Could Reshape Global Oil Trade After Months Of War: Report
summary: A report says a potential US-Iran deal could reshape global oil trade after months of conflict. The war has disrupted energy flows, lifted oil prices and raised concerns over the Strait of Hormuz.
why: Brent crude is the global benchmark for oil, and disruptions in Gulf shipping routes directly affect crude supply costs and energy-sector earnings.
why_moved: The report of a potential deal to end the conflict is described as reshaping global oil trade after months of disruption to energy flows and shipping.
